Ethiopia's Council of Ministers took up the draft Ethiopian Statistics Proclamation on 26 May 2026, a bill on the Statistical Service's independence, oversight and executive roles, and data confidentiality; the passage shown does not state the referral decision, and the document's date is used.

The document is the text of the Central Statistics Authority Establishment Proclamation No. 442/2005, published in the Federal Negarit Gazeta on 20 April 2005, which sets up the Authority and governs statistical activities.
